use IO.Std.write_line
use Ghul.Coroutines

class EVENT is
    _signalled: bool
    _waiting: int
    _gate: SEMAPHORE

    init() is
        _gate = SEMAPHORE(0)
    si

    wait() -> COROUTINE is
        if !_signalled then
            _waiting = _waiting + 1

            await _gate.acquire()
        fi
    si

    signal() is
        _signalled = true

        for _ in 1::_waiting do
            _gate.release()
        od

        _waiting = 0
    si

    reset() is
        _signalled = false
    si
si

let event = EVENT()
let delay = 3

waiter(name: string) -> COROUTINE is
    write_line("{name} waits")

    await event.wait()

    write_line("{name} released")
si

signaller() -> COROUTINE is
    for _ in 1::delay do
        await pause()
    od

    write_line("signalled")

    event.signal()
si

waiter("first")
waiter("second")
signaller()

run()

waiter("third")

run()

event.reset()

waiter("fourth")

run()

write_line("fourth is still waiting")

event.signal()

run()
